name: co-VC dimension of Addressing
details: For every n>=1, independently of the bit encoding.
proof: On the n private address coordinates, the all-zero labeling is absent, but every labeling differing from it at exactly one coordinate is realized. This is a hollow star of size n. Conversely, a minimally inconsistent sample of size k has, for each of its k deleted examples, a concept consistent with the remaining sample. These k concepts are distinct: a concept witnessing two deletions would satisfy the full inconsistent sample. Hence k cannot exceed the n concepts. Thus co-VC is exactly n, also at n=1.
